name: stakeholder_report_quality_v1
description: Rubric optimized for stakeholder-facing fairness reports with actionable remediation.

dimensions.description: Writing is concise, unambiguous, and understandable by non-technical stakeholders.
Recommendations are concrete, prioritized, and measurable.
Claims are grounded in provided context and supported by credible research citations.
Severity labels and narrative logic stay consistent across attributes.
No internal contradictions between diagnosis, severity, and mitigation.
